slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total weekly profit, or is the goal to minimize total weekly cost while satisfying the requirement that profit is at least 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what should be optimized and offered profit maximization as an option, directly covering the objective-function slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: No question or assumption check mentions minimizing idle time or unused capacity of any process, or any cost-proportional secondary objective; the READY_TO_MODEL treats the goal as profit maximization alone.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is only to maximize weekly profit, with no secondary objective of minimizing process idle time weighted by the hourly process costs.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization or any multi-objective requirement, and its READY_TO_MODEL 'Confirmed Understanding' lists only profit maximization as the objective without flagging idle time as an unconfirmed point.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time-minimization objective was never asked about and remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, so the stop was premature.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the profit-maximization objective and several constraint interpretations, but never probed the P1 idle-time minimization / cost-weighted secondary objective, silently assuming profit maximization alone before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
